name: Will-o'-Wisp

source.note: The 2024 Will-o'-Wisp. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against SRD 5.2.1 or the book. Unsure: Shock's attack bonus and damage, and the resistance list. Consume Life, Vanish and its light are text only.

traits.name: Variable Illumination
traits.summary: Glows; it can brighten, dim or put out its light at will.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.

actions.name: Shock
actions.summary: A jolt of lightning from its glowing body.

bonus_actions.name: Consume Life
bonus_actions.summary: A living creature at 0 Hit Points within 5 ft makes a DC 10 Con save or dies; the wisp regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points.

bonus_actions.name: Vanish
bonus_actions.summary: Turns Invisible, light and all, until it attacks, uses Consume Life or loses Concentration.

summary: A drifting light that lures travellers astray: lightning jolts, hard to hit, and it can wink out of sight.
